scenes.edit: Use the frontal stadium portrait to establish the original athlete wearing the user's navy PSG top, with the full torso, collar, sleeves, cuffs, and hem visible in the original composition and sunlight; accurately place the white swoosh, PSG crest, and QATAR AIRWAYS lettering, replace the quilted chest with the reference fabric texture, and establish the blue shoulder accents and grey sleeves for consistent movement and detail shots; use the supplied rear reference to maintain the plain navy back.

shots.note: Front-facing upright portrait with arms relaxed beside the body; the framing moves from a torso-dominant view toward the face and chest, keeping the zipped collar and front garment surface clearly visible.

Three-quarter front view during a torso rotation and sweeping arm warm-up; one sleeve passes across and partly obscures the chest while the other arm extends behind, with natural fabric tension at the shoulders and waist.
Rear view facing the goal; bent arms move near the waist before lowering to the sides, showing the back panel, rear collar, shoulder seams, sleeves, and hem above the unchanged trousers.
Front three-quarter jogging view with elbows bent and hands alternating beside the lower chest and waist; the top moves with the torso and forms shifting folds around the abdomen and elbows.
Close three-quarter view of the neck and upper torso; the athlete's raised hand grips and adjusts the short zipper at the stand collar, partially covering the zipper and upper chest.
Cropped front torso view; one hand releases the collar area while the other pinches and pulls the lower hem beside the hip, stretching the front fabric above the unchanged trouser waistband.

Tight frontal detail of the stand collar, short zipper, and chest with no hands present; the replacement's textured navy fabric and chest graphics occupy the area originally covered by the white quilted panel.
Close three-quarter crop showing the lower face, collar, chest, and wearer's left shoulder and upper sleeve; the arm hangs down, exposing the sleeve surface and shoulder construction.

Centered frontal standing portrait with arms relaxed and hands beside the hips; the framing gradually tightens, prominently displaying the collar, chest graphics, grey sleeves, blue shoulder accents, and navy torso.
